$comment: Cross-language conformance vectors for token accounting — the single source of truth
for how a telemetry entry's token total is computed. integrity-sdk's
BOTH read this file in their tests, so the two implementations cannot drift apart
silently. That mattered: they previously drifted into the same double-counting bug
(summing total_tokens AND prompt_tokens AND completion_tokens), and because both sides
were wrong in the same direction, no reconciliation could reveal it.
1. Base = provider-computed total_tokens when present; otherwise the sum of the two
halves (prompt+completion, or the input/output aliases). NEVER both — total_tokens
already equals prompt+completion in every provider that reports it.
and the flattened cache_creation_tokens / cache_read_tokens) are ADDITIONAL to
completion_tokens respectively, and are NEVER added — doing so double-counts.
4. Flat top-level metadata input_tokens/output_tokens are used only when token_usage
contributed nothing, so a single call is never counted twice.

vectors.name: openai_all_three_keys
vectors.why: The shape that caused the original bug: total_tokens present alongside its own components. Must equal total_tokens, not 2x it.

vectors.name: openai_components_only
vectors.why: No provider total — sum the halves.

vectors.name: anthropic_with_cache
vectors.why: Anthropic reports no total_tokens, and cache tokens are ADDITIONAL to input_tokens.

vectors.name: openai_cached_tokens_is_a_subset
vectors.why: prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens is part of prompt_tokens; adding it would double-count the cached portion.

vectors.name: flat_metadata_form
vectors.why: Integrations that put tokens at the top level rather than under token_usage.

vectors.name: flat_and_nested_not_double_counted
vectors.why: When token_usage already contributed, the flat keys describe the same call and must be ignored.

vectors.name: flattened_cache_keys
vectors.why: The shape Claude Code's OTLP events use (cache_read_tokens rather than cache_read_input_tokens).

vectors.name: empty_metadata
vectors.why: An entry with no usage data contributes nothing rather than erroring.

vectors.name: null_token_usage
vectors.why: LangChain emits token_usage: null when llm_output is absent.

vectors.name: non_numeric_values_ignored
vectors.why: Never coerce junk into a score input.

vectors.name: zero_total_falls_back_to_components
vectors.why: Some providers emit total_tokens: 0 alongside real components (streaming partials).

vectors.name: negative_values_ignored
vectors.why: A negative count is never legitimate and must not reduce the total.
